hint_ladder.title: Meaning
hint_ladder.text: Compensatory means something that compensates, i.e., makes up for a loss, damage, or deficiency. It's about restoring balance.

hint_ladder.title: Synonym
hint_ladder.text: The best synonym is 'Offsetting'. Think of compensatory damages in law — they are meant to offset the harm suffered.

hint_ladder.title: Apply to Scenario
hint_ladder.text: A, C, D are about punishment. Compensatory is about restoration, not punishment. Which means 'offsetting'?

hint_ladder.title: Determine Correct Answer
hint_ladder.text: Option B is correct because 'offsetting' captures counterbalancing a loss, the essence of compensatory.

A.text: You might have chosen A because 'penal' sounds legal, but compensatory is about making amends, not punishment.

B.text: Correct. Offsetting means counterbalancing, just like compensatory damages restore what was lost.

C.text: You might have chosen C because punitive damages exist, but compensatory is for restoration, not punishment.

D.text: You might have chosen D because retributive justice is well-known, but it's about payback, not compensating.

next_time_rule: Tandaan: Compensatory = offsetting. Pag may nasira, kailangan palitan, hindi parusahan!
deconstruct_text:
Isipin mo si Tita Lorna, may sari-sari store sa barangay. Nasagi ng truck ang tindahan niya, nasira ang paninda. Yung insurance ng truck driver, nagbigay ng compensatory payment para ma-offset ang nawala, hindi para parusahan ang driver.

‘Compensatory’ means serving to compensate—making up for a loss, damage, or injury. It’s about restoring balance, not punishing.

Habang ang ‘penal’, ‘punitive’, at ‘retributive’ ay tungkol sa parusa, ang compensatory ay tungkol sa pagbabayad o pagpuno sa kulang. Kaya 'offsetting' ang tugma.

Mental trick: Tuwing marinig mo ang 'compensatory', isipin mo 'compensate'—kapag may nasira, kailangan palitan o i-offset, hindi parusahan. Kaya 'offsetting' ang sagot!
